title: SoulChest
description: Modern Paper plugin for creating protected death chests with GUI management, teleportation, XP storage, holograms, and inventory recovery, built for performance, reliability, and seamless gameplay.
body:
## ⚰ SoulChest

SoulChest is a modern, high-performance death chest plugin for Paper servers. It automatically stores a player's inventory, armor, off-hand items, and XP inside protected death chests, ensuring items are never lost after death. Built with asynchronous data handling and a powerful management GUI, SoulChest provides a reliable and lag-free death recovery experience.

---

## ⚙️ How It Works

* When a player dies, a protected soul chest is created automatically
* The chest stores inventory contents, armor, off-hand items, and XP
* Use `/sc chests` to open a GUI and manage all active soul chests
* Players can teleport to, fetch, unlock, preview, or delete their chests
* Holograms display chest information, death cause, and expiration time
* Safe location detection prevents chests from spawning in void or lava
* Permissions control chest limits and available features
* Fully asynchronous database operations ensure zero TPS impact

---

## 📋 Commands

* `/sc chests` → Open your soul chest GUI
* `/sc chests <player>` → View another player's chests (admin)
* `/sc tp <id>` → Teleport to a soul chest
* `/sc fetch <id>` → Move a soul chest to your location
* `/sc unlock <id>` → Unlock a soul chest
* `/sc delete <id>` → Delete a soul chest
* `/sc toggle` → Enable or disable soul chest spawning
* `/sc version` → Show plugin version
* `/sc reload` → Reload configuration
* `/sc admin delete <player> <id>` → Delete a player's chest
* `/sc admin tp <player> <id>` → Teleport to a player's chest
* `/sc admin view <player> <id>` → Preview chest contents
* `/sc admin setlimit <player> <n>` → Set a player's chest limit
* `/sc admin resetlimit <player>` → Reset a player's chest limit
